attchmntText: Bombay Coated and Special Steels Limited has informed the Exchange about Investor Presentation
sm_name: Bombay Coated and Special Steels Limited
voiceSummary: Bombay Coated and Special Steels Limited filed an investor presentation for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. The company listed on BSE and NSE on 5th November 2026, raising Rs. 183.05 Crore through its public issue. It acquired 8.48 acres of industrial land at Supa, Maharashtra. Financial highlights for FY26 show revenue from operations at 12,668 Mn, EBITDA at 891 Mn, and PAT at 305 Mn. Revenue CAGR from FY24 to FY26 was 29.51%. EBITDA margin was 7.03% and PAT margin was 2.41%. For H1 FY27, revenue from operations was 6,773.19 Mn. Home and commercial appliances accounted for 86.90% of revenue. The company serves 215 customers. It is an authorized service partner for JSW Steel. The earnings conference call is scheduled for Wednesday, November 25, 2026, at 4:00 p.m. IST.

attchmntText: Bombay Coated and Special Steels Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026.
sm_name: Bombay Coated and Special Steels Limited
voiceSummary: Bombay Coated and Special Steels Limited approved its Unaudited Standalone Financial Results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. The Board meeting was held on November 23, 2026, from 05:30 p.m. to 06:30 p.m. The results were reviewed by statutory auditors Shah, Shah and Shah. The auditors issued a review report stating that nothing came to their attention to suggest material misstatements. The financial statements were prepared in accordance with Indian Accounting Standard 34. The disclosure was submitted to BSE and NSE under SEBI Listing Regulations. The company secretary is Sonam Dilipkumar Gupta. The auditor's membership number is 49361. The UDIN is 26049361SPQZDE4046.

attchmntText: Bombay Coated and Special Steels Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated November 20, 2026, titled "Press Release for taking physical possession of Supa Land".
sm_name: Bombay Coated and Special Steels Limited
voiceSummary: Bombay Coated and Special Steels Limited took physical possession of MIDC Plot No. E-5 at Supa Parner Industrial Park, Maharashtra, on November 19, 2026. The plot measures 34,300 square metres, approximately 8.48 acres. The company filed this press release under Regulation 30 on November 20, 2026. The land is intended to support future infrastructure development and expansion for the Home Appliances and Automotive industries. The company will execute the Agreement to Lease within 30 days from the date of possession. Bombay Coated and Special Steels Limited operates four manufacturing facilities at Wada, Bhiwandi, Ghiloth, and Sri City.

attchmntText: Bombay Coated and Special Steels Limited has informed the Exchange about General Updates
sm_name: Bombay Coated and Special Steels Limited
voiceSummary: Bombay Coated and Special Steels Limited took possession of Plot No. E-5, admeasuring 34,300 square metres, at Supa Parner Industrial Park, Taluka Parner, District Ahilyanagar, Maharashtra, from the Maharashtra Industrial Development Corporation on November 19, 2026. The company states that this land is procured for future business expansion. This intimation is filed pursuant to Regulation 30 of the Securities and Exchange Board of India Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements Regulations, 2015. The announcement was issued by Sonam Dilipkumar Gupta, Company Secretary and Compliance Officer.

attchmntText: Bombay Coated and Special Steels Limited has informed the Exchange about Schedule of meet
sm_name: Bombay Coated and Special Steels Limited
voiceSummary: Bombay Coated and Special Steels Limited will host an earnings conference call on Wednesday, November 25, 2026, at 4:00 p.m. IST. The call is scheduled to discuss the Unaudited Standalone Financial Results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. This event will take place following the announcement of the results. The company has provided dial-in numbers and registration details for analysts and investors. The invite is available on the company website at www.bcsspl.in. The intimation is filed pursuant to Regulation 30 read with Part A of Schedule III of SEBI Listing Regulations. The notice was issued by Company Secretary Sonam Dilipkumar Gupta.
